$comment: Tony's Pizza Fantasy — locked palette. 32 colors. Every generated asset is quantized to exactly these values during processing; this file is the mechanism that keeps independently generated batches looking like one world. Do not add, remove, or edit a color without regenerating every affected asset.
status: PROVISIONAL — locked on approval of art test batch B0

ink.role: Outlines, text, shadow anchors. Warm-biased so it never reads as pure black.

wood.role: Paneling, tables, counter, booth frames, floors.

red.role: Checkered cloth, vinyl booths, sauce, signage.

paper.role: Menus, newspaper, receipts, napkins, pizza-box print.

amber.role: Incandescent light, warm key, cheese, brass, lamp glow.

blue.role: Night, cool ambient fill, Detroit-adjacent jerseys, cold neon.

violet.role: Deep shadow in the underground, epic treatment, neon accent.

skin.role: Avatar and character skin. Four steps spanning a usable range. Managers select a step; it is not tied to any other palette role.

semantic.$comment: Semantic roles map to ramp entries. Never introduce a new hex for a semantic role.
semantic.shadowRule: one step darker within the same ramp — never ink-900, never pure black

rarity.$comment: Rarity must never be communicated by color alone. These reinforce the frame geometry and label required by 06 §8.

prohibited.$comment: Never sample or introduce these, regardless of what a generation returns.
prohibited.note: Pure black flattens the warm bias; pure white blows out against paper-white. Both are common image-model defaults and must be quantized away.
